scope: UUID packaging maintenance; documentation and build/test infrastructure only. Native Qore/C++ behavior unchanged. A nameless QPP documentation annotation does not change native logic; Valgrind is not required for this comment-only edit.

root_causes.documentation: The qpp file annotation names the original input, while Doxygen sees generated output. Keep a nameless file annotation. Current committed docs already use public generated declarations and separate release notes.
root_causes.cmake: Policy compatibility predates supported CMake; the required uninstall template is absent; CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR was passed but unused. Java-binding generation is optional and outside the native RPM payload.
root_causes.make_tests: The Autotools test list retained the pre-rename uuid-test.q path. Use the tracked qtest and debugging flags; stop on the first failure.
root_causes.uninstall: Provide the missing manifest-based target with no shell interpolation, full prevalidation, DESTDIR support, and parent-symlink escape checks.

set -eu
mkdir -p /work/home /work/rpmbuild
rpm -qa --qf '%{NAME} %{EPOCHNUM}:%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}.%{ARCH}\n' | sort > /work/installed-packages.txt
exec rpmbuild "$@"

set -eu
unset QORE_MODULE_DIR QORE_MODULE_DIR_ONLY QORE_INCLUDE_DIR LD_LIBRARY_PATH LD_PRELOAD
rpm -V qore-uuid-module qore-uuid-module-doc
cd /tmp
qore -b --enable-debug /source/test/uuid-test.qtest -v
doc_index=$(rpm -ql qore-uuid-module-doc | grep '/html/index.html$')
test -s "$doc_index"
for p in qore-devel gcc gcc-c++; do if rpm -q "$p"; then exit 1; fi; done

preliminary_attempts.candidate1: File annotation and strict docs passed, but current SDK exposed CMake deprecation, missing uninstall template and unused variable diagnostics.
preliminary_attempts.candidate2: Fixture composition error: overlaid current CMake docs registration onto the older pinned archive, duplicating release notes. Replaced the base with complete current committed documentation; no product suppression.
preliminary_attempts.candidate3: All suites passed, but qdx requested optional Java bindings without JNI. The native RPM now explicitly selects QORE_GENERATE_JAVA_BINDINGS=OFF, matching the existing module packaging policy.

gates_remaining: Native OBS builds and installed ARM qualification

source_download_policy.change: Source0 now points to the OBS-hosted generated archive, following the existing NATS generated-source policy. Exact revision and SHA256 pins remain in source-manifest.json.
source_download_policy.gate: After canonical upload, fetch the public source URL and verify its SHA256 against the canonical manifest before distribution.
